notes: Operator-editable bootstrap fallback for sync-workspace-step4c.js. Used ONLY when no monitor/integrity/sync-workspace-runs-*.json sentinels exist (true first run, or after a retention purge). After the first sentinel lands, on-disk sentinels become the source of truth and this value is irrelevant on the hot path. Bump if you redeploy the helper after a long pause and want the upstream-newer-than-last-sync check to compare against a more recent floor (avoids spamming spurious sync triggers from ancient history).

delete_propagation._notes: PROP-124 / DIRECTIVE-20260707-001 (2026-07-08) Phase 2 TRANSITION — TEMPORARY BACKLOG-DRAIN config. enabled=true flips delete-propagation ON. abort_abs TEMPORARILY raised 500→1500 to allow the 1,135-file Phase-0 backlog (all monitor/integrity/*.json past retention, 100% DELETE_PATTERNS match, verified by tinker Part A 2026-07-08) to drain without the delete-sanity gate deadlocking. per_cycle_cap=200 UNCHANGED is the durable blast-radius throttle — at most 200 files delete per cycle, self-draining over ~6 cycles. RESTORE abort_abs=500 once a sentinel shows candidates<200 (steady state) — the 1500 value REMOVES the PROP-051-class mass-delete disaster gate and MUST be reverted after drain. Pause/rollback is a single config push back to enabled=false.

overwrite_propagation._notes: PROP-092 (2026-06-13) Phase 0 — manifest-only. Sibling to delete_propagation. enabled=false → every dome-mirror cycle writes overwrite_propagation.items + per-file decision into its sentinel but performs no copies. Operator reviews ≥3 days of manifests before flipping enabled=true (Phase 2). Pause/rollback is a single config push back to enabled=false. Scope: 12-entry hard-coded OVERWRITE_ALLOWLIST in sync-workspace-step4c.js (latest-*-summary.txt across all global pipeline agents). Defaults per_cycle_cap=abort_abs=20 are defensive bounds larger than the whole allow-list; aborts at >20 candidates with zero writes. Unlike PROP-091, fs.copyFileSync truncate-write WORKS on FUSE (no unlink dependency) so Phase 2 is expected to actually write; EPERM fallback to manifest-only remains for safety.
